[SWS_CM_12006] Asynchronous nature of Subscribe()
⌈
In order to keep applica-
tion functionality robust against Network Binding configuration changes, applications
shall assume asynchronous operation when calling Subscribe().
This implies not assuming success in the subscription process until GetSubscrip-
tionState() or the handler set by SetSubscriptionStateChangeHandler()
have reported kSubscribed, even if Subscribe() has returned with no error.
⌋
